{{Quote|Will you please rid me of this curse?!|Menth Paul|<ref name="SWG:ToOW">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan]]''</ref>}}
'''Menth Paul''' was a treasure hunter who resided in the [[Mensix Mining Facility/Legends|Mensix Mining Facility]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].

While exploring the vast [[Planet/Legends|world]] of Mustafar, Menth came across a mysterious shard. After picking it up, he seemed to be cursed, suffering much misfortune. Menth wanted to go home and be rid of the shard, but could not afford a ticket off Mustafar. One day, he came across a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] and offered to sell him the shard so he could afford the ticket. The spacer agreed and Menth purchased a ticket offworld, leaving the shard in the hands of a spacer. Some say the spacer suffered bad luck, attacked by swarms of [[Lava flea/Legends|lava fleas]] not long after the purchase, others say he destroyed the shard by throwing it into the lava.

==Behind the scenes==
Menth Paul appeared as a non-player character in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
